title: RetrievalResult
description: Candidate context/evidence found by RCA for a moment-specific query. Retrieval produces candidates, NOT truth, authority, or cross-scope permission. Scope/policy eligibility happens before ranking. A retrieved item is not automatically citable; a citable item is not automatically mutable. Similarity is a ranking signal, never permission. Denied/escalated cross-scope candidates are recorded without leaking their content. Each candidate carries its metadata bundle and provenance/citation ranges.

scope_policy_prefiltered.description: Asserts scope/policy eligibility was applied BEFORE ranking. Out-of-scope and suppressed material is excluded before any vector/similarity step; ranking never reintroduces it.

candidate_items.description: The surfaceable candidate items found, each with its metadata bundle, admissibility status, and (where admitted/cited) provenance/citation ranges. Candidate evidence is distinct from admitted evidence. Denied/escalated cross-scope material is NEVER carried here (it would leak object id/scope/provenance); it is recorded only in the content-free denied_or_escalated_candidates list.

metadata_bundle.description: Embedded metadata bundle carrying object_type, source_role, authority_state, evidence_role, scope_id, derived_from/provenance for this candidate.

admissibility_status.description: Restricted to surfaceable values (candidate, admitted, redacted, requires_confirmation). Denied/escalated material is not represented as a metadata-bearing candidate; see denied_or_escalated_candidates.

evidence_role_in_context.description: The role this candidate would play in the current context. May be downgraded from its intrinsic evidence_role; never upgraded by retrieval.

ranking_signals.description: Why this candidate ranked where it did (similarity, recency, etc.). Signals inform ordering; they do not confer permission, admissibility, or authority.

admitting_cross_scope_flow.description: The CrossScopeFlow that admitted this candidate if it crosses a scope boundary.

applicable_cross_scope_flows.description: Typed CrossScopeFlow grants applicable to this retrieval. Required and may be empty; cross-scope candidates are admissible only under one of these.

denied_or_escalated_candidates.description: Cross-scope or out-of-scope material that was found relevant but denied or escalated. Records the reason and any required flow WITHOUT leaking content or a metadata bundle. Denied material must never become hidden context.
